retired_requirements.reason: Compresses technical-documentation timing, updating, compliance demonstration, minimum content, SME/SMC simplified-documentation rules, Commission form-establishment duty, notified-body acceptance and product-law integration into one article-level abstraction.
Compresses lifetime automatic logging, purpose-appropriate traceability, three distinct logging purposes and four biometric-identification log fields into one article-level abstraction.

migration_notes: Article 11(1) reflects the 2026 amendment introducing simplified technical-documentation treatment for SMEs, start-ups and SMCs, including the Commission duty to establish a targeted simplified form.
Article 11(3) is retained as an institutional permission because it can change Annex IV's minimum technical-documentation content; it is not represented as a provider duty.
Article 12(3) applies specifically to high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III point 1(a).
For Article 6(1) systems, the 2026 Article 2(13) limitation mechanism may affect Articles 11 and 12 only where its statutory conditions and delegated-act mechanism are satisfied.

requirements.requirement_summary: Draw up technical documentation for the high-risk AI system before it is placed on the market or put into service.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Technical documentation for a high-risk AI system
timing_or_frequency: Before placing on the market or putting into service.

requirements.requirement_summary: Keep the technical documentation for the high-risk AI system up to date.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Technical documentation for a high-risk AI system
timing_or_frequency: Keep up to date after creation.

requirements.requirement_summary: Prepare technical documentation so it demonstrates compliance with Section 2 and gives national competent authorities and notified bodies the necessary clear and comprehensive information to assess compliance.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Technical documentation for a high-risk AI system
verification_method: Assessment of the documentation by competent authorities or notified bodies, as applicable.
constituent_propositions: provide necessary information to national competent authorities and notified bodies
provide information in clear and comprehensive form

requirements.requirement_summary: Include at least the elements specified in Annex IV in the technical documentation.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Technical documentation for a high-risk AI system
required_artefacts: Technical documentation containing Annex IV elements

requirements.requirement_summary: SMEs, including start-ups, and SMCs may provide the Annex IV technical-documentation elements in the simplified manner established for them.
applicable_actor: SME, start-up or SMC provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Technical documentation for a high-risk AI system
exceptions_or_qualifications: Use of the simplified approach is optional and limited to qualifying SMEs, start-ups and SMCs.

requirements.requirement_summary: Establish a simplified technical-documentation form targeted to the needs of SMEs, including start-ups, and SMCs.
governed_object: Simplified technical-documentation form for SMEs, start-ups and SMCs
applicability_conditions: Applies to the simplified Annex IV technical-documentation mechanism introduced in Article 11(1).

requirements.requirement_summary: A qualifying SME, start-up or SMC that chooses simplified Annex IV documentation must use the Commission's simplified technical-documentation form.
applicable_actor: SME, start-up or SMC provider of a high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies where a qualifying SME, start-up or SMC opts to provide Annex IV information in simplified form.

requirements.requirement_summary: Notified bodies must accept the simplified technical-documentation form for conformity-assessment purposes.
applicability_conditions: Applies to the simplified form established for SMEs, start-ups and SMCs.

requirements.requirement_summary: For a high-risk AI system related to a product covered by Annex I Section A Union harmonisation legislation, draw up a single technical-documentation set containing both Article 11(1) information and the information required by that legislation.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Technical documentation for a product-related high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies where the high-risk AI system is related to a product covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I, Section A.

requirements.requirement_summary: The Commission may amend Annex IV by delegated act where necessary so that, in light of technical progress, technical documentation continues to provide all information needed to assess compliance with Section 2.
applicability_conditions: Applies where amendment is necessary in light of technical progress.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Delegated acts are adopted in accordance with Article 97.

requirements.requirement_summary: Design high-risk AI systems to technically allow automatic recording of events (logs) throughout the system lifetime.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Logging capability of a high-risk AI system
timing_or_frequency: Over the lifetime of the system.

requirements.requirement_summary: Provide logging capabilities that support a level of traceability of system functioning appropriate to the intended purpose.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Logging capability and traceability of a high-risk AI system

requirements.requirement_summary: Enable logs to record events relevant to identifying situations that may result in a risk under Article 79(1) or a substantial modification.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Logging capability of a high-risk AI system

requirements.requirement_summary: Enable logs to record events relevant to facilitating Article 72 post-market monitoring.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Logging capability of a high-risk AI system

requirements.requirement_summary: Enable logs to record events relevant to monitoring operation of the high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 26(5).
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Logging capability of a high-risk AI system

requirements.requirement_summary: For Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI systems, record the start and end date and time of each use.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Logs of an Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III point 1(a).

requirements.requirement_summary: For Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI systems, record the reference database against which system input data was checked.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Logs of an Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III point 1(a).

requirements.requirement_summary: For Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI systems, record the input data for which a search produced a match.
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Logs of an Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III point 1(a).

requirements.requirement_summary: For Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI systems, record the identity of the natural persons involved in verification of results under Article 14(5).
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Logs of an Annex III point 1(a) high-risk AI system
applicability_conditions: Applies to high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III point 1(a).
